archetype_rationale: For a conversion-focused freelance developer (Webfoot), the site needs to scream authority, precision, and modern technical capability. Dark mode with stark high-contrast typography and a bold, aggressive accent color builds instant trust without falling into the generic 'tech blue' trap.

headings.usage: Use font-black for H1/H2, tracking-tight. Never center large headings by default. Import via Fontshare or use Outfit.

body.usage: Use leading-relaxed. Text color must be high contrast (at least #D4D4D4 against #0A0A0A).

mono_accents.usage: Use for overlines, tech stack tags, step numbers (01, 02). Always uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em].

spacing_and_layout.general: Follow generous padding: py-24 or py-32 for sections. Mobile-first grids.
spacing_and_layout.services_section: Use MODE A: 'Tetris' Bento Grid (cols-1 md:cols-12, gap-8). Asymmetrical cards.
spacing_and_layout.tech_capabilities: Use 'Retro-Futurism' Terminal look. Grid with visible borders (border-collapse).
spacing_and_layout.hero: Asymmetrical. Huge typography. Left-aligned text, right-aligned floating visual or abstract image overlaid with black/50.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (#121212), crisp 1px border (#262626). No soft shadows. On hover: border changes to brand_accent/50.
surface_strategies.buttons: Sharp corners or max rounded-sm. Solid fill for primary. 1px border for secondary.

motion_and_interactions.animations: Lenis for smooth scrolling. Framer motion for staggered fade-ups on the bento grid.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with subtle glow. Text color explicitly defined on hover.

icons_and_assets.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Keep them sharp and professional.
icons_and_assets.whatsapp_sticky: Must be fixed bottom-right, z-50, shadow-2xl, rounded-full, with a pulsing animation ring.

hero_visual.description: Dark minimalist laptop workspace, close up on keyboard. Use with a heavy gradient overlay (black/70 to transparent) for contrast.

portfolio_project_1.description: Computer screen with 'the modern way to build for the web' - modern web app mockup.

portfolio_project_2.description: Web page with 'design workflows' - SaaS/Business platform mockup.

process_visual.description: Black laptop on wooden table, representing the execution and delivery phase.

section_guidelines.hero: H1: 'Conversion-Focused Websites for Local & Online Businesses' (text-5xl to text-6xl+). Left-aligned. Dual CTA: WhatsApp (solid primary) and View Services (outline).
section_guidelines.services: Bento Grid. 3 cards. Card 1 (Business Web Dev) spans more columns than others. Cards must have internal p-8.
section_guidelines.tech_capabilities: Use a Marquee ('The Living Texture') for the tool stack (React, Node, MongoDB, Tailwind). Use 'react-fast-marquee'.
section_guidelines.process: 3-step list. Use vertical connecting lines to show progression. Steps: Understand, Design & Develop, Launch.
section_guidelines.portfolio: Image-heavy grid. Hovering over an image reveals business type and description with a backdrop blur.
section_guidelines.why_choose_me: Heavy typography. Big stats or bold statements. Differentiate from agencies by emphasizing direct communication.
section_guidelines.contact_and_pre_footer: Contact form stored in MongoDB. Inputs must be Shadcn UI customized (flat, border-b only, or solid dark background). Email placeholder: hello@webfoot.dev. Sticky WhatsApp button is paramount.
section_guidelines.footer: Massive 'Let's Talk' text. Webfoot branding, developer name 'Alex', simple copyright credit.

testing_requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, form inputs, links, WhatsApp CTA) MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-whatsapp-btn').
instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout structures. Shadcn for form inputs/dialogs only. Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Satoshi for body (import from Fontshare, or use Outfit/Manrope as fallback). Adhere strictly to the dark theme color palette. Ensure the sticky WhatsApp button is globally visible.
